payload.title: Separate complete inventory from incomplete semantic analysis
payload.description:
Observed behavior: a portfolio run can enumerate its entire score inventory while selected semantic diagnoses return incomplete evidence. The living Report currently labels this as complete coverage, which overstates the completed analysis and obscures why the run is incomplete.

Feature: Distinct inventory and analysis completeness

Scenario: Complete inventory with incomplete diagnosis results
Given exhaustive score inventory coverage is complete
And a scheduled semantic diagnosis returns an incomplete result
When the living Report publishes the terminal milestone
Then the Report identifies portfolio inventory coverage as complete
And identifies semantic analysis as incomplete
And reports the count of returned incomplete diagnoses separately from execution failures and safety-cap deferrals

Scenario: Complete semantic analysis
Given exhaustive score inventory coverage is complete
And every policy-selected semantic diagnosis completes without an incomplete result or deferral
When the living Report publishes the milestone
Then semantic analysis is labeled complete

Scenario: Analysis still in progress
Given policy-selected semantic diagnoses have not yet reached a terminal result
When the living Report publishes an intermediate milestone
Then semantic analysis is labeled pending rather than complete.

Out of scope: changing ranking, diagnosis selection, safety caps, or optimizer authorization.
